coverage_note: 48:18-49:25 Medi on a phone call in English (not lesson). 22:00-22:18 Amal away. Engine: قتلت/القتلى = عطلتي/العطلة; أوروس = عرس; صريك = probably 7akaitlek; أكلنا (16:47) = 7akulna per chat; بيت هم = biddhom; إمنا = mnaa7; أشطن (Amal 50:24) = أشتغل; 'أحسن issue' = a7san ishi. Echo: 'This.' (38:26) may be لسه (low). Questions not scored: 07:42 kul vs kul el- (Amal: that's every), 46:20 kul hadol, 46:44 ykoonu, 55:47 عمل غلطة (Amal: both fine). 34:22 aa5er September accepted by Amal. Self-fixes left out: 51:19 ما بقدر->ما راح أقدر, 53:08 جوعانة->جوعان, 45:10 سيء->سهل, 28:30 الصف->الشتاء.

rows.medi_said: ممكن لازم أروح أو أجاوب الـ telephone
rows.amal_said: أجاوب الـ phone؟ ... No. You don't جاوب التليفون.
rows.why: Wrong verb for answering a phone: Amal said 'You don't جاوب التليفون' and he switched to أرد (02:18); she confirmed أرد.
rows.english: I might have to go or answer the phone

rows.chat: ana basta3mel Headpphone u microphone jdaad. awal marra basta3melhom
rows.why: He used بشتغل (work) for 'use' (he even started أستـ at 02:56); after his repeat بشتغل له at 03:55 she said 'بس تستعمل...' and typed basta3mel (sheet: use | Esta3mel).
rows.english: I'm using new headphones and a microphone

rows.amal_said: Just dad، not state. ... His microphone و headphone too.
rows.why: Two things need the plural adjective: Amal said 'jdaad not jdeed' (engine: 'Just dad, not state') and he said جداد at 03:41/03:47.
He referred to two things (headphones and mic) with له; her typed line has the object ending -hom on the verb; she voiced only the verb, not the ending.

rows.amal_said: we say سماعة. So like we make them plural as well. ... سماعات is headphone.
rows.why: He used English 'headphone' and asked about it; Amal supplied سماعات (not on her sheet) - a didn't-know.
Speaking to Amal (female) he used the masculine بتقدر; her chat has bte2dari; she did not voice it.
He asked 'do I know how to say difference?' and tried مختلف then غير; Amal said No and gave فرق (sheet: difference | Farq). They said it at the same time, so low.

rows.medi_said: uh، so فارق بين I would say
rows.why: Right after Amal's فرق he said فارق; her chat has el-farq. Could be the engine.

rows.medi_said: أنا أكيد صريك إنه عند الزباين.
rows.chat: ana 7akaitlek enno 3indna zabaayen. a5uy byeshte8el ma3hom
rows.why: He meant 'we have clients' but left 3ind with no ending (and added el-); her typed line is enno 3indna zabaayen; not voiced.
rows.english: I told you we have clients

rows.why: Plain present without b-; her typed line has byeshte8el; she said only 'Okay'.
el- put on aa5er in a chain (aa5er el-usbuu3); Amal did not voice a fix and moved on to kul el-3utle.

rows.amal_said: No. She only planned. ... No. How many days in to plan؟ ... خططنا.
rows.why: Wrong stem for 'we planned' (5a66eina / 5a66na / 5attna); Amal said No twice and gave خططنا (sheet: i planned | Ana 5a66atet).
Doubled verb rann takes -eina in the past 'we' form; she recast to رنينا and he repeated it at 09:33.
rann takes 3ala (sheet: i call | Ana barenn (3ala)); she asked what it takes and he added على at 09:43.

rows.amal_said: What did we say about مية؟ ... What do we add؟ ... Meet.
rows.why: miyya becomes meet before a noun; she prompted until he said ميت at 10:37.

rows.amal_said: مطعم. ... لا. It's more than 10، so.
rows.why: After 100 the noun is singular; Amal said مطعم and 'It's more than 10', he fixed to مطعم أو مكان at 10:59.
He said 'something different' for 'other things'; Amal pushed 'Other things' / ishi taani and he said إشي تاني at 11:27 (sheet: another… / else | Noun + tani).
awal + noun = first, no el-; she questioned 'الأول؟' and he went (via أول المكان) to أول مكان at 12:35.

rows.amal_said: لقينا. ... Did you add an أ؟
rows.why: Wrong form of la2a 'we found'; she said لقينا and asked if he added an أ. Could partly be the engine.

rows.chat: mumken bas awal makaan la2ainaah lissa a7san ishi.
rows.why: Object fronted (awal makaan) so the verb needs -h pointing back; her typed line la2ainaah; her voiced fix had no -h.
rows.english: the first place, we found it

rows.amal_said: لسه. What's the best؟ How do we say the best؟
rows.why: 'the best' needs a7san ishi; she asked how to say the best and he answered أحسن إشي (engine 'أحسن issue') at 13:19.

rows.medi_said: Option. Starts with a fair، right؟ ... خوار، right؟
rows.why: He asked for 'option' (sheet: option | 5ayaar | خيار), guessed خوار, Amal gave خيار.

rows.medi_said: So would you say إحنا بدنا هـ-آآ، هبنا؟
rows.amal_said: No. How do you say wanted؟
rows.chat: e7na dayman kaan bidna 3urus barra amrica
rows.why: Past 'wanted' needs kaan + bidna; she said No and prompted 'How do you say wanted?' and he said كان بدنا at 16:10. Framed half as a question, so medium.
rows.english: we always wanted (a wedding outside America)

rows.why: Wrong owner ending 'their' for 'our friends'; she asked 'whose friends?' and gave صحابنا. The engine's صباحنا may be his own fix before her, so low.

rows.medi_said: لما كل أدا، بي نفس مكان،
rows.chat: u lamma el-kul fi nafs el-makan
rows.why: 'everybody' is el-kull; she asked for everybody and he said الكل at 18:10.
rows.english: when everyone is in the same place

rows.medi_said: آآآ، نفس مكـ-- آآ، نفس مكان،
rows.amal_said: Nuffs same place. Nuffs takes شو؟ ... Nuffs takes ل أو no؟
rows.why: nafs + el- + noun; she asked what nafs takes and he said نفس المكان at 17:52.

rows.amal_said: And because we have لما what do we need؟
rows.why: A general 'when..., it is special' needs bikoon; she prompted and he said يكون at 18:29.
Noun + el-adjective needs el- on the noun too; Amal moved on.
Asked which season it is, he said winter, then spring, then a made-up خيس (23:12); she said No twice and typed 5areef, noting it is the word he struggles with most (sheet: autumn / fall | 5areef).

rows.medi_said: Is it مستـ... مستأجر؟ مستأجر؟ No.
rows.why: He thought محادثة meant 'future' (24:09) and could not find 'future'; Amal supplied مستقبل.
Noun + el-adjective needs el- on both (her chat: el-5areef el-maadi); her voiced 'لا، خريف' does not clearly target the el-. Same again at 28:13.

rows.amal_said: أكتر. The most. ... What's the most؟ Yes.
rows.why: 'the busiest' = adjective + aktar ishi; she pushed 'The most' and he said مشغولين أكتر إشي at 29:11.
Feminine first word of an idafa takes -t (her chat shajaret); Amal said Great. The engine may hide the -t.
The tree is feminine so 'on it' is 3alaiha; she twice said شجرة to point at the gender; he said 'أه'.

rows.amal_said: If there's two verbs only the first one is past. The other one is present.
rows.why: The second verb after 'started' must be a bare present verb; she named the rule and he said ندرس at 31:33.

rows.medi_said: احنا, um, بدأت، uh, ندرس عربي.
rows.amal_said: إحنا أو أنا، بديت أو بدينا.
rows.chat: e7na badaina / ballashna nedrus ma3 ba3ad.
rows.why: Subject e7na with the 'I' past form; she contrasted ana badeit vs e7na badaina.
5areef is masculine and takes el- with el-mufaddal; he used the feminine المفضلة and no el- on خريف; she praised it.

rows.medi_said: Motivation is، آآ، متشجع and ... motivated is حافز.
rows.wrong: Motivation is متشجع ... motivated is حافز
rows.why: He swapped the two words; Amal said 'the opposite' and he fixed it (sheet: incentive / motivation | 7aafez; motivated | Mitshajje3).
'a lot of things' needs the plural; she echoed كتير and he said أشياء at 40:00.
rows.english: I have a lot of things

rows.why: The verb needs the object ending for 'things to do'; she questioned أعمل؟ and he said أعملهم.

rows.amal_said: What is nervous؟ Are you nervous؟ ... مضغوط.
rows.why: She asked for 'stressed'; he gave متوتر (sheet: nervous / anxious | Mitwatter); she pointed out it means nervous and gave مضغوط (sheet: stressed / under pressure | Mad8oo6).
He (male) used the feminine form; Amal replaced the word without addressing gender.
'they change' (get changed) needs the t- form; she said no and he said بيتغيروا.
'one of them' (things, masculine) is waa7ad; she gave واحد and he said واحد منهم.
7ayaa is feminine so the verb is tkoon; she prompted with حياة and he said تكون at 45:03.
Feminine 7ayaa takes the feminine adjective; she said سهلة and he repeated it.
Her typed line puts aktar after the adjective (sehla aktar); he kept اكتر first and she did not voice it.

rows.medi_said: اذكر حالي-- على حالك. ... اذكر حالي
rows.why: 'remind myself' is the doubled form azakker (sheet: i remind | Bazakker); he said اذكر; not voiced.

rows.amal_said: لا، if كل هدول الأشياء، وا-- ... مناح.
rows.why: He dropped to bare أشياء; she said لا and restated كل هدول الأشياء then مناح.

rows.medi_said: دائمًا أحس-- أحس، ... دائمًا أحس so.
rows.why: Plain present needs b-; she said بحس (he repeated أحس هيك at 49:54, still without the b-).
English 'so' dropped into the Arabic; she supplied هيك (sheet: like this / this way | Heik | هيك).
Repeating her 'you must work less' with أنا he kept the you-form; she said أشتغل (engine wrote أشطن) and he said أشتغل أقل.

rows.medi_said: عشان لما عندي، ... لما عندي, right?
rows.why: 3indi in a future when-clause needs ykoon; she prompted لما then gave يكون عندي.

rows.medi_said: أنا كنت راح-- أنا راح كنت...
rows.why: He switched to راح كنت; she said لا, كنت راح is right.

rows.amal_said: كنت راح. You can't just say I will. You can't just say راح on its own.
rows.chat: ana kunet ra7 aakol, bas ma kunet ju3aan.
rows.why: ra7 needs a verb after it; she named the rule and he said كنت راح آكل at 52:52.
rows.english: I was going to eat but

rows.why: Feminine noun salata takes the feminine adjective; Amal did not fix it.

rows.medi_said: أو الـ grammar اللي بغلط، uh، I get wrong.
rows.why: The preposition with its ending must close the illi clause; she said بغلط فيها and he repeated بغلط في.

rows.medi_said: uh، أكثر سهل إلا-- uh، إليك.
rows.chat: ana laazem a3malo sehel aktar ilek
rows.why: Her typed line puts aktar after the adjective (sehel aktar); not voiced.
For 'practice them' Amal said أتدرب (sheet: i practice | Ana batdarrab); engine wrote أضرب three times, possibly a sound-alike of adarreb.

rows.amal_said: It's one of the collocations. ... صح، أتدرب عليهم.
rows.why: tdarrab takes 3ala (sheet: i train / practice | Ana batdarrab 3ala); she said it is a collocation and he added عليهم at 59:13.
